method.motion_frames: Steps0..63 with per-frame common edge mask (union of the two raw shadow masks), identical camera/light/jitter paths. Pairwise differences include kernel and Monte Carlo effects and are not ghosting/noise estimates.
method.post_frames: Steps64..95 camera stationary. Metrics against matching-jitter phase means of each variant static stage include recovery plus any residual state difference; they are not ground-truth error.
method.post_noise: Same-phase residual RMS on the shared static 1024-disk-reference edge mask; separates steps64..79 and80..95, two frames per jitter phase per window. Values include recovery, not only random noise.
method.units: Linear HDR luma for source/output; [0,1] visibility for shadow; motion uses UV*1920x1080 pixels.
